title: Anthony Page, Vic Gaspar and the Excelsior Band
summary: Questions on Anthony Page and Vic Gaspar, who played baritone and slide with the Excelsior Band; Barbarin was hired as an extra.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Ask him about Anthony Page. Did he know Anthony Page?
You know a fellow by the name of Anthony Page?
Uh-huh.
Anthony Page. You know a fellow by the name of Anthony Page?
No. Tell him he taught Vic Gaspar. He taught Vic Gaspar.
He taught Vic Gaspar. He learned Vic Gaspar how to play. You know him?
Maybe Vic Gaspar went to the fellow that killed him.
Oh, no.
You know he went to the examen, and they find him unfit to be a liver.
Oh. He never...
He never... Gaspar.
Yeah, but I know that. But the man that... That he went to... To learn music. The man that teached him music. You know the man that Mr. Vic went to learn how to play music with?
No.
You don't know.
Yeah, well... Ask him what Vic Gaspar played in those days.
What Vic Gaspar played in those days?
He played baritone, slide, play anything. So it was a brass instrument, you know? Mm-hmm. He was a good scholar, you know?
What bands was he with?
What bands was Mr. Vic playing with?
Who?
Vic Gaspar.
He played with the Excelsior Band.
Mm-hmm. And ask him when he was... When he himself was with the Excelsior.
Uh, did you play at Mr. Vic the same time with the Excelsior Band? Did you play at the Excelsior Band?
Yeah, I played once or twice with him. But that was a regular band. Mm-hmm. Vic was a member of the band, you know? Mm-hmm.
But was he a member?
They used to hire me to play. Mm-hmm. You...
You... You wasn't a regular member of the band, though? No. No, he didn't belong to the band. He just would play when he needed an extra band.
